title: Itinerary Templates
notes: Migrated to ListPage archetype (search+filterbar+infinite scroll+skeleton+hover row actions+bulk delete+CSV export of full filtered dataset via a direct high-limit fetch, not just loaded rows). Preview and create-from-template stayed as dialogs, not a Sheet detail drawer, since the preview is a quick read-only card, not a full entity detail view — detailDrawer left false. No relation/phone/address/currency/date fields exist on this entity, so those contract items are not applicable (left false). DELETE /api/v1/itinerary-templates/:id wired for row and bulk delete (previously orphaned/no UI). POST /from-itinerary remains orphaned — no 'save itinerary as template' entry point exists on the itinerary detail page, which is out of this slice's fileAllowlist (desktop/src/app/(app)/itineraries/templates/**). Added to sidebar under Operations as 'Itinerary Templates'.
